transcript:
okay so we're at the lake house for the weekend which means the whole
routine is basically out of the window, which is fine, it's intentional,
no Novothor obviously, no treadmill, no HUME scale, we went for a hike
this morning, actually a proper one, maybe two and a half hour, the
trail up to the ridge, there was a quite a lot of elevation, probably
400 meters of gain, I felt great honestly, legs were strong, lungs were
good, no heart rate data because I forgot the polar at home, had a
really big lunch at a place called Trattoria something, I don't remember
the name exactly, in the village at the bottom, big pasta, a glass of
wine, finished maybe around two o'clock, then we just kind of lazed
around in the afternoon, sat by the lake, had dinner at home, well at
the house, Mary cooked some kind of fish dish, really good, ate around
7.30, done by 8.30 roughly, I did take supplements, I packed the morning
ones, so the NAC, berberine, creatine, alpha lipoic acid and Relight,
sorry Relight, skipped the afternoon ones because I forget to pack them,
the vitamin D, K2, fish oil, those are back in London, I'm sleeping way
better here actually, the air is just different, Oura says 8 hours 10
minutes last night, deep sleep was 1 hour 45, which is unusually high
for me, HRV was 74, genuinely feeling great.
